items.title: 52150_Charlie Barnet oral history interview
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] In addition to your Atlantic crossings, John Chilton mentions that you also crossed the Mediterranean...

ctx.x: No. Like I say, they didn't have a very good reputation amongs -- now, my God, everybody's playing them. But even when I started playing it there, I -- besides Johnny Hodges and Sidney Bechet, that's about all there was.
Uh-huh. In addition to your Atlantic crossings, John Chilton mentions that you also crossed the Mediterranean and cruised to South America. Is that right?

Well, I was on a Mediterranean cruise in 1926 with my parents, at the conclusion of which we visited Paris and London, but I did play on a Caribbean cruise on the old Mauritania, the old four stacker.
